doc: Frozen instrument for I23a (historical on-chain acquisition and early per-edge replay; human answer Q5 in docs/HUMAN_ANSWERS.md). Fixes the chain, the contract, the event topics, the window and the sources before any historical item is fetched.

Rollup.abi: contracts/contracts/l1/rollup/IRollup.sol and Rollup.sol at the same commit

window.from_reason: Dencun (EIP-4844) activation on mainnet. Morph commits carry blobs. Completeness is checked, not assumed (I23a-P8: the earliest CommitBatch in the window must be batch 1).
window.to_reason: the finalized block at the prereg (2026-10-12)

limits.observed: at the prereg the public execution RPC accepted an eth_getLogs range of 1972 blocks and refused 10000 (HTTP 403); historical state (eth_call, eth_getStorageAt and eth_getCode at old blocks) needs an archive token

snapshot_dir: ~/.holon/historical (override: env HOLON_HISTORICAL_DIR); never inside the repo
